filters.videosHint: Play song videos (muted) with the preview

errors.CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE: Song catalog could not be loaded
errors.FORBIDDEN_ROLE: Your access level does not allow this action
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts: try again in 15 minutes
errors.CROSS_ORIGIN_REQUEST: Request refused: it does not come from this application
errors.SONG_CHANGED: The song file was changed elsewhere since it was displayed: close and reopen it, then try again.
errors.UNENCODABLE_CHARACTER: "{character}" cannot be saved in this file (encoding {encoding}).
errors.CONVERSION_FAILED: Conversion check failed: the file was not changed.
errors.FFMPEG_NOT_AVAILABLE: ffmpeg not found: set FFMPEG_PATH in .env.
errors.CONVERSION_BUSY: Another ffmpeg task (video conversion or MP3 creation) is running: wait for it to finish.
errors.VIDEO_TARGET_EXISTS: {file} already exists in the song folder: nothing was changed.
errors.VIDEO_ALREADY_H264: This video is already MP4 H.264, at most 1080p.
errors.VIDEO_CONVERSION_FAILED: Video conversion failed: nothing was changed.
errors.VIDEO_IS_AUDIO: The video file is also the audio file (#MP3): converting it would remove the music.
errors.MUSICBRAINZ_BUSY: MusicBrainz is busy: try again in a moment.
errors.MUSICBRAINZ_NO_QUERY: The artist and title are needed to search MusicBrainz.
errors.PLAYLIST_CHANGED: The playlist was changed elsewhere: reopen the menu and try again.
errors.PLAYLIST_READ_ONLY: Playlists cannot be changed (no backup folder).
errors.AUDIO_NOT_SHARED: The music is already a separate file.
errors.AUDIO_EXTRACTION_FAILED: The MP3 could not be created: nothing was changed.
errors.REPLAYGAIN_FAILED: The ReplayGain could not be measured.
errors.REPLAYGAIN_NOT_MP3: ReplayGain can only be written to MP3 files.
errors.REPLAYGAIN_TAG_UNSUPPORTED: This MP3 has an ID3 tag that cannot be changed safely: nothing was written.
errors.FILE_LOCKED: The file is used by another program or is read-only (player, UltraStar, synchronisation, antivirus…): nothing was changed. Close it and try again.
errors.FOLDER_CHANGED: The folder changed since the simulation: the list was computed again, check it and try again.
errors.PLAYLIST_WRITE_FAILED: The playlist could not be updated.
errors.MEDLEY_ORDER: The medley must end after it starts.

warnings.ENCODING_UTF8_BOM: UTF-8 with BOM: UTF-8 without BOM expected
warnings.VIDEO_IS_AUDIO: Same file for the music and the video: {file}
warnings.VIDEO_TOO_LARGE: Video {width}×{height}: larger than 1080p, heavy for UltraStar (1080p is enough)
warnings.NAMING_BACKGROUND_IS_COVER: The background is the same image as the cover ({file}) and the folder has no other image: the #BACKGROUND entry will be removed

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Enter the access key given by the library owner.
auth.localHint: Full access: you are on the PC running the server.
auth.publicHint: Browsing and listening are open to everyone. Sign in with a key to edit.
auth.signInHint: Sign in to edit (write or admin key)

details.title: Song details
details.error: Could not read this song file.
details.creator: Creator
details.namingTitle: Names do not follow the rules

edit.identityHint: Also applied to the other .txt files of the folder (solo, duet…) and to the playlists that list the song. Scores already saved in UltraStar stay under the old name.

encoding.hint: Rewrites the file in UTF-8 without BOM: same text and line endings, dated backup first.
encoding.converted: File converted from {from} to UTF-8 (without BOM). Backup: {backup}

textRepair.hint: The text was saved with the wrong encoding. The repair restores the right characters; nothing is written until you confirm, dated backup first.

bulk.title: Bulk corrections
bulk.intro: Each correction is simulated first: nothing is written until you confirm. Every changed file is backed up first.
bulk.changedSinceSimulation: changed since the simulation: skipped (simulate again)

utf8.title: Convert to UTF-8 (without BOM)
utf8.hint: Rewrites files saved in another encoding (or with a BOM): same text and line endings.
utf8.none: All song files are already in UTF-8 without BOM.

video.title: Convert videos to MP4 H.264
video.hint: Original resolution kept, reduced to 1080p if larger (never enlarged). Videos are converted one after the other in the background: you can close this window.
video.none: All videos are already MP4 H.264.
video.space: The originals are moved to the backups: plan about {size} of free disk space for the selected videos.
video.stopped: Batch stopped: {converted} converted, {errors} error(s), {skipped} not processed.
video.isAudio: also the music (#MP3): create the MP3 from the details window first
video.noBackup: Backup of the originals disabled in the preferences: the original videos will be deleted after conversion.

audio.title: Create the MP3 of videos used as music
audio.hint: Songs whose #MP3 is the video file. The music is extracted to an MP3 next to the video, then #MP3 points to it; the video is not changed (it can be converted afterwards). Runs in the background: you can close this window.
audio.none: No song uses its video as music.

found.one: {count} song uses its video as music.
found.other: {count} songs use their video as music.

audio.stopped: Batch stopped: {created} MP3 created, {errors} error(s), {skipped} not processed.

replayGain.title: Add ReplayGain to MP3 files
replayGain.hint: Measures the loudness of each MP3 without ReplayGain and writes it to its ID3 tag (same as the button in the details window). The audio data does not change. Runs in the background, a few seconds per file: you can close this window.
replayGain.none: Every MP3 already has its ReplayGain.
replayGain.space: Each MP3 is copied to the backups before writing: plan about {size} of disk space for the next batch.
replayGain.summary: Batch done: {written} ReplayGain written, {errors} error(s), {skipped} already done.
replayGain.stopped: Batch stopped: {written} ReplayGain written, {errors} error(s), {skipped} not processed or already done.
replayGain.noBackup: Backup of the MP3 files disabled in the preferences: only the ID3 tag is rewritten, no copy.

video.hint: Original resolution kept, reduced to 1080p if larger (never enlarged). Light to play for UltraStar and browsers.
video.planNew: {from} will be converted to {to}; #VIDEO will be updated and the original moved to the backups.
video.planReplace: {from} will be replaced by its H.264 version; the original will be moved to the backups.
video.duration: This can take a few minutes.
video.done: Video converted: {file}. Original saved in the backups: {backup}
video.unavailable: ffmpeg not found: set FFMPEG_PATH in .env to enable conversion.
video.isAudio: The video file is also the song’s music: create the MP3 file first (warning above), then the video can be converted.
video.planNewNoBackup: {from} will be converted to {to}; #VIDEO will be updated and the original deleted (backup disabled in the preferences).
video.planReplaceNoBackup: {from} will be replaced by its H.264 version; the original will not be backed up (disabled in the preferences).
video.doneNoBackup: Video converted: {file}. Original not backed up (preferences).

musicbrainz.title: MusicBrainz
musicbrainz.intro: Look up the exact spelling of the artist and title, the year, language and genre of this song on MusicBrainz, then choose what to keep.
musicbrainz.noResult: Nothing found on MusicBrainz for this artist and title.
musicbrainz.hint: Ticked values replace the current ones. Nothing is written until you apply.

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.none: No playlist in the playlist folder.
playlists.readOnly: Sign in with write access to add or remove this song.

audio.hint: Extracts the music from the video into its own MP3 file (the video is not changed), then the video can be converted.
audio.plan: {to} will be created from the soundtrack of {from}; #AUDIO / #MP3 will point to it. The video is not changed.
audio.planReuse: {to} already exists (created for another version of this song): #AUDIO / #MP3 will point to it.
audio.doneReuse: Music now points to the existing {file} ({headers} updated). Backup: {backup}

replayGain.hint: ffmpeg measures the song (89 dB reference, like MP3Gain); you confirm before anything is written. Only the ID3 tag changes, not the sound.
replayGain.written: ReplayGain written to the MP3 (ID3 tag). Backup: {backup}
replayGain.writtenNoBackup: ReplayGain written to the MP3 (ID3 tag). No backup of the MP3 (preferences).

warningTypes.VIDEO_IS_AUDIO: Same file for music and video

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.namingIntro: Expected name of each item. Use {artist} and {title} (from #ARTIST and #TITLE); the extension is not checked. Untick an item to stop checking it.
preferences.saved: Preferences saved: the library was re-read (naming) and the backup settings are applied.
preferences.invalid: A pattern is invalid: see the field in red.

errors.PATTERN_TOO_LONG: Pattern too long (200 characters at most).
errors.PATTERN_FORBIDDEN_CHARACTER: Characters \ / : * ? " < > | are not allowed in file names.

preferences.backupsIntro: Copy of the original to the backup folder (BACKUP_DIR) before each write. Song files and playlists are always backed up; large files may be left out.

backupKinds.txt: Song .txt files (headers, encoding, rename, MP3 created…)
backupKinds.videoConversion: Video conversion to MP4 H.264 (original video)
backupKinds.replayGain: MP3 ReplayGain (MP3 before its tag is written)

backupHints.videoConversion: Off: the original video is deleted after conversion.
backupHints.replayGain: Off: only the ID3 tag changes, the audio data is copied unchanged.

rename.title: Rename to the naming rules
rename.intro: The folder and all its files, with the name suggested by the naming rules (Preferences). Every name can be edited, even a compliant one. Files used by no .txt have no suggested name: they only change if you rename them.
rename.unencodable: "{character}" cannot be written in {txtFile} (Windows-1252 encoding): convert this file to UTF-8 first.
rename.undone: Rename undone: the original names and .txt files are back.
rename.noIdentity: #ARTIST or #TITLE is missing: no name can be suggested, but you can type one.

errors.TRAILING_DOT_OR_SPACE: A name cannot end with a dot or a space.
errors.RESERVED_NAME: Name reserved by Windows (CON, NUL, COM1…).
errors.TOO_LONG: Name too long (200 characters at most).
errors.DUPLICATE: Another file already has this name.
errors.EXISTS: A folder already has this name.

timingHelp.BPM: Careful: changing the BPM shifts every note. Only for a known correction (e.g. from Yass).
timingHelp.GAP: Milliseconds before the first beat. Shifts every note against the music.
timingHelp.VIDEOGAP: Seconds: video − music. Positive = the video starts further in; negative allowed. Empty = 0.
timingHelp.PREVIEWSTART: Seconds from the start of the music. Empty = automatic (medley, otherwise the player's choice).
timingHelp.MEDLEYSTARTBEAT: Beat where the medley excerpt starts (whole number). Empty = remove.
timingHelp.MEDLEYENDBEAT: Beat where the medley ends (whole number), after its start. Empty = remove.
timingHelp.START: Seconds: the music starts here. Empty = remove.
timingHelp.END: Milliseconds: the song stops here. Empty = remove.
